_comment: Game-specific scenarios for tinypond. Tier 2.6t. Locks down core ecology cascades: clock advance, sunlight calc, plant growth, fish-eat-plant, hunger.

scenarios.name: clock_advances_time
scenarios._: After 100 ticks, time_of_day should have changed from initial (offset 0.25 = noon).

scenarios.name: sunlight_high_at_noon
scenarios._: Initial state is 'noon' (offset 0.25 in time_of_day cycle). After ~5 ticks, sunlight should be near 1 (sin(0.25 * 2π) = sin(π/2) = 1).

scenarios.name: plants_grow_in_sunlight
scenarios._: Reset plant_s_1 (existing seed) to known sunlit state. After 10 ticks of growing in sunlight, growth has risen but seed hasn't transformed yet (transform at growth >= 100; grow_rate = 5 → 10 ticks = 50, still seed).

scenarios.name: fish_eats_mature_plant
scenarios._: Reset existing fish_1 to known state, drop mature plant 5 units away. Contact rule should fire within a few ticks: -30 hunger, +1 score.

scenarios.name: fish_hunger_rises_over_time
scenarios._: Reset fish_1 hunger to 0 and place it where no plants exist (so it can't eat). After 30 ticks (10 fires of creature_hunger_rises every 3 ticks), hunger must have risen.
